blocks.text: Acreage and rural land in Salmon River
What acreage trades in Salmon River: whole fee-simple farm and rural-residential parcels along the river valley and on the 56 Avenue upland — acreage is the market here.
The ground in Salmon River

items.t: Fee-simple parcels are the acreage form: Houses are farm and acreage houses on large rural lots along the river valley and on the upland by 56 Avenue, under the Township Rural Plan designations and Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 (the district's farm and acreage homes sit in the rural zones, including RU-2). A Salmon River acreage purchase is a fee-simple title purchase: City/Township zoning, ALR rules where the parcel is in the reserve, flood position, and any registered covenants on title govern.

Serviced vs unserviced ground: rural properties may use wells; search GWELLS, the provincial database of registered wells and mapped aquifers, for a parcel's record (well reports are due within 90 days of constructing, altering or decommissioning a well). Parcel-level servicing for any Salmon River acreage: Not confirmed until the GWELLS record and the Fraser Health sewerage filing for that parcel are read.
The Township development applications route was checked and no condo project and no townhome project inside the district was named; presale projects in the district: Not verified / none named.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Salmon River

items.t: Parks and facilities: the Salmon River Natural Area is a Township park listed in the Township Annual Report among the Fort Langley-area parks. No recreation centre or library branch inside the district was confirmed; the nearest Township facilities are in Fort Langley and Walnut Grove. Few or no stores inside the district; the nearest store named with its address on a Township page is Lee's Market, 23320 Mavis Avenue, Fort Langley.

Health: Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, Langley, is the Fraser Health community hospital with 24/7 emergency serving the area, southwest of the district; the Langley Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 202 - 20434 64th Avenue, Langley.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect acreage buyers in Salmon River

items.t: Zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500: Rural land is under Bylaw 2500; the district's farm and acreage homes sit in the rural zones, including RU-2 (RU-2 minimum lot area and frontage: Not verified from a readable bylaw section — confirm the parcel's zone and section through the Township's GeoSource Map Schedules).
Plans: the Township Official Community Plan and the Rural Plan govern the district: Metro Vancouver watershed planning covers the Salmon River watershed.

items.t: 23% on a base of 22 is a small-numbers market: Price from the parcel, not the ratio.

The nearest named store is in the next community: Lee's Market, 23320 Mavis Avenue, Fort Langley, is the nearest store named with its address on a Township page — Salmon River acreage living is Fort Langley / Walnut Grove serviced, and the district itself has few or no stores.

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: streets and boundaries

items.t: Salmon River is a Langley Township watershed of about 77 square kilometres (km²) that drains from Abbotsford through the Township to the Fraser River's Bedford Channel.
The river's outlet is controlled, not free-flowing: it discharges through the Salmon River Pump Station outlet flood boxes at the Fraser River.
Tidal influence reaches far inland here — the Township states Fraser River tidal influence extends as far upstream as Highway 1 because of the river's flat gradient.
The Uplands fabric beside the valley is the small-lot acreage pattern buyers see on the ground; its plan status is read in the Township's Rural Plan layer in GeoSource, not from a neighbourhood plan.

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: the housing stock

items.t: Land use in the watershed mixes agricultural activities and residential areas, each with distinct drainage and flood needs, as the Township states.
Low-lying parcels are part of the working drainage system: the Township notes standing fish can be left in agricultural fields and other low-lying areas after flood events.

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Zoning is Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, which applies to the whole Township and sets permitted uses, lot coverage and building restrictions parcel by parcel.
A Salmon River proposal is checked in GeoSource against rural land use designations, development permit areas, watercourses and trees before an application is made.
In the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), a principal residence is capped at 500 square metres (m²) and a secondary suite must sit entirely within that principal residence.
Small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) does not apply to lots over 4,050 m² (1 acre), and eligible lots need both municipal water and sewer — most valley acreages fail one or both tests.

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The original Salmon River Pump Station was built in 1949, a larger axial pump replaced one unit in 1984, and a new station with a fish-friendly screw pump was built beside it in 1997.
Flood boxes, not pumps, move most water: the Township states the six flood boxes often handle more water than all the drainage pumps combined when Fraser levels are low.
Peak flows pull in opposite seasons — peak Fraser River flow is in June, peak Salmon River flow is around November, per the Township's pump-operation data.
The river provides spawning, rearing and overwintering habitat for numerous fish species, which is why pump operation is federally restricted outside freshet.
School catchment is by street address in School District 35's (Langley) School Locator Tool, not by the Salmon River name.

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: development and new projects

items.t: The project installs a second fish-friendly screw pump (adding 2,000 litres/second, doubling screw capacity to 4,000 litres/second) and replaces the 1984 axial pump with a fish-friendly axial pump (1,500 litres/second).

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: costs and taxes

items.t: A Salmon River tax notice includes drainage among its levies, alongside roads, solid waste and capital projects — drainage is a real line in a flood-valley watershed.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT) list includes the Township of Langley, so residential owners here are in a designated taxable area.

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: getting around

items.t: Movement here is by road to the river crossings and Highway 1; the Township's own flood description uses Highway 1 as the upstream marker for tidal influence in the valley.
Property information for a trip or a viewing starts in GeoSource, which shows road access as a site feature for each parcel.
No rapid transit serves the Salmon River acreages; the Township's only Transit Oriented Area is on 196 Street in Willowbrook for the proposed Surrey-Langley SkyTrain station.

blocks.text: Salmon River Acreages and Farms: risks and due diligence

items.t: Flood is the headline risk: the Township models reduced flood extents for 10-year and 200-year winter storm events only after the pump upgrades, so today's protection is the existing system.

When flood boxes stay closed for hours or several days on the tidal cycle, water accumulates in the Salmon River — a buyer should ask for the parcel's flood history in a winter event, not only freshet.
Watercourse and development permit layers are checked in GeoSource's Environment and Planning layers before any building or subdivision plan.
In the ALR, septic needs health authority approval and fill may need an Agricultural Land Commission Notice of Intent, both listed by the ALC as separate approvals.

faq.q: Can an acreage add a second dwelling?
faq.a: Three routes, kept separate: (1) on ALR land, the ALC additional-residence rule above; (2) under the Township's SSMUH rules (Bylaw 6020, which has no six-unit tier), a suite or accessory unit on lots over 4,050 m² depending on zoning, with the Township suite cap at 120 m²; (3) a coach house as a fee-simple s.102 unit (second storey of a detached garage, never strata).

faq.q: Which schools serve a Salmon River acreage?
faq.a: SD35, address-based. The settled sample (4452 256 Street, single-address basis) returns North Otter Elementary and D.W. Poppy Secondary, with no middle school shown by the locator; Coghlan Fundamental Elementary at the same address is a district choice school on the upland east side (its position inside this board sub-area is not confirmed), and no school physically inside the valley was confirmed. Run the exact address before marketing a home on a school.

faq.q: Is there any transit in the district?
faq.a: Only at the edge: route 562 runs on Glover Road at the Fort Langley edge (Langley Centre to Walnut Grove / Carvolth Exchange); no route inside the valley roads was confirmed, and there is no SkyTrain or West Coast Express station in the district — price the acreage as car ground.

faq.q: Does a Salmon River acreage flood?
faq.a: Low-lying land here can flood, and the mechanism is specific. When Fraser River levels rise, the pump station flood box gates close to stop upstream flooding; the Salmon River then cannot drain by gravity, so water accumulates until tides drop or pumps run — check the parcel's elevation and the floodplain layer in GeoSource before subjects.

faq.q: Can I add a second detached house for family?
faq.a: In the ALR, only within the Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) limits: one additional detached residence, up to 90 m² on properties 40 hectares or less, if there is only one existing residence when construction begins, and only if Township zoning also allows it on that lot.

faq.q: How do I check a specific lot's constraints?
faq.a: Start with the Township's GeoSource mapping tool. The Township directs users to view zoning, approximate lot dimensions, community and neighbourhood plan area, development permit areas, and site features like watercourses, trees and road access there — then confirm accuracy with a British Columbia land surveyor (BCLS).
